steps.what: Supervise students' laboratory work and intervene when technique or equipment use needs correction

tasks.design: Retain direct engineering laboratory supervision. Existing instructions in {DOCS} support the teacher without replacing observation of student activity.
tasks.previous_blocker: Laboratory behaviour may require immediate intervention.
tasks.enabler_now: No replacement for direct supervision is proposed.
tasks.still_hard: Recognising unsafe setup and misunderstood measurements.
tasks.human_edge: The teacher sees what students actually do and adapts guidance.

reach.task: Explain an equipment issue affecting student work

evidence.claim: Direct laboratory supervision remains contextual human work; no saving is assumed.

assumptions: Boundary is teacher supervision, excluding technician setup, student execution, and separate marking.
Teacher observes activity during s1; course team supplies existing instructions beforehand. No structured safety flag is assumed.
Native document access suffices; unchanged supervision adds zero upkeep.
research_questions: Which observed actions require immediate intervention?

incremental.description: No additional system or process upkeep

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100; net zero because direct supervision is unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Compile, administer, and grade engineering examinations

steps.what: Compile examinations and define the marking rubric and exact closed-item rules
Administer the examination and collect submitted student answers
Calculate closed-item examination marks using the checked answer rules
Grade open engineering answers and assess reasoning against the rubric
Resolve marking exceptions, verify totals, and authorise final examination results

tasks.design: Configure exact closed-item scoring in {LMS} after the teacher checks the examination and rules. Retain construction, administration, open-answer reasoning, exception resolution, and final result authorisation.
tasks.previous_blocker: Exact matching may be repeated manually after the answer rule is settled.
tasks.enabler_now: Native assessment tools support closed-question marking.
tasks.still_hard: Partial credit, alternative valid methods, units, and demonstrated understanding.
tasks.human_edge: The examiner recognises valid engineering reasoning beyond an expected solution.
tasks.altitude: Less exact scoring; examiner authority and open-answer evaluation remain unchanged.

evidence.claim: Ans supports automatic closed-question marking and distributes open answers to markers.
The engineering examination saving is an E1 scenario without local measurements.

assumptions: Boundary is teacher examination effort, excluding student answering and registrar entry. Staff delegation is not itself a saving; assigned marking must be counted once under its actual owner.

Teacher produces item identifiers, answer keys, accepted units, tolerances, rounding rules, point values and rule version in s1. Capture and validation stay counted. Ambiguous alternatives and partial reasoning require manual marking.
Students produce answers during the examination after release in s2; existing platform functionality records response and item identifiers. No response feed is available earlier.
Test native configuration before custom code. Existing automatic marking runtime earns no new saving. Examiner authorisation and applicable national institutional rules remain required.
research_questions: Do unit conversions or valid alternative answers cause false rejects?

approvals.approved_version: Exact student-item marks, resolved exceptions, totals and examination version; changes void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=85; gross 15 minus 7 upkeep gives net 8. Range assumes genuine manual closed-item marking; open-problem examinations or existing automatic scoring may save nothing.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Collaborate on teaching and research issues

steps.what: Collaborate with colleagues to address engineering teaching and research issues

tasks.design: Retain direct academic discussion and problem solving. Shared material in {DOCS} supports colleagues' reasoning and agreement.
tasks.previous_blocker: Academic issues involve incomplete evidence and differing interpretations.
tasks.enabler_now: No replacement for direct collaboration is proposed.
tasks.still_hard: Reconciling assumptions and choosing a useful shared action.
tasks.human_edge: The teacher challenges an explanation and works through disagreement.

evidence.claim: Academic collaboration remains human communication; no saving is assumed.

assumptions: Boundary is teacher participation, excluding underlying research, curriculum writing and separate secretariat work.
Participants supply existing concerns and evidence before and during s1. No structured issue feed or new capture is required.
Native document sharing suffices; unchanged discussion adds zero upkeep.
research_questions: Which issues require direct cross-disciplinary discussion?

incremental.description: No additional system or process upkeep

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100; net zero because academic dialogue remains unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Evaluate curricula against student difficulties, learning evidence, and engineering developments
Choose revised learning objectives, sequence, engineering examples, and instructional methods
Write revised curriculum explanations from the chosen instructional changes

loop.purpose: Draft wording for teacher-selected curriculum changes
loop.input: revision brief, selected sources and current curriculum
loop.output: curriculum proposal draft with source and change links
loop.check: Teacher checks physical reasoning, prerequisites, outcome alignment and preserved engineering assumptions
loop.stop: One draft and one correction; unsupported explanations are rewritten manually
loop.why_not_simpler: Substantive instructional explanations need more than fixed form fields

steps.what: Validate the revised curriculum and identify programme approval requirements

tasks.design: Keep evaluation and engineering teaching choices human. A bounded draft in {DOCS} expresses selected changes before substantive validation and normal programme approval.
tasks.previous_blocker: Revision prose must preserve linked technical and instructional choices.
tasks.enabler_now: A teacher brief and selected sources constrain first-draft wording.
tasks.still_hard: Choosing prerequisites and a sequence that develops engineering understanding.
tasks.human_edge: The teacher connects observed misconceptions to better learning progression.
tasks.altitude: Less revision wording; curriculum decisions remain with teacher and programme governance.

reach.task: Map engineering outcomes to learning activities

evidence.claim: Teacher-constrained curriculum drafting may reduce prose effort; no local time or learning improvement is measured.

assumptions: Boundary is curriculum evaluation and revision proposals, excluding test construction, laboratory supervision, and formal programme approval.

Teacher produces objective identifiers, prerequisite changes, content choices, example assumptions, sequence and method rationale in s2. Source selection and capture stay counted. Incomplete briefs or unsupported technical claims require manual revision.
Test native templates and revision tracking first. Aggregate course evidence is prepared in s1; identifiable student records do not enter drafting.
research_questions: Does independent review find incorrect physical assumptions or lost prerequisites?

incremental.description: Maintain the brief and check recurring drafting errors

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=91.25; gross 8.75 minus 4 upkeep gives net 4.75. Range assumes bounded changes with selected sources; major redesign may save nothing.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The engineering teacher retains laboratory, assessment and curriculum judgement while checking exact scores and bounded revision drafts.
role.ambitious_version: A teacher who reduces exact marking and rewriting while preserving laboratory presence and academic accountability.
